title: Full Differentials and Linear Hulls for SKINNY
summary: SKINNY's existing differential and linear bounds cover single characteristics; extending them to full differentials and linear hulls remains open.

formal_statement.body: For $\mathrm{SKINNY}$, extend the existing differential and linear bounds beyond single characteristics by analyzing full differentials and linear hulls, including the aggregate probability or correlation arising from multiple contributing characteristics.

scope.domain: Differential and linear cryptanalysis of the SKINNY block cipher.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Extend the single-characteristic bounds to full differentials and linear hulls, accounting for aggregate probability or correlation from multiple contributing characteristics.

citations.label: The SKINNY Family of Block Ciphers and Its Low-Latency Variant MANTIS

progress.summary: The paper gives differential and linear bounds for individual characteristics, then identifies analysis of differentials and linear hulls as a complex task left for future work.
citation_labels: Christof Beierle et al., The SKINNY Family of Block Ciphers and Its Low-Latency Variant MANTIS
